**1 — Scene:** A small rice-and-vegetable salad or stir-fry, with leafy greens and two thick rounds of corn on the cob.

**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using a 27 cm circular approximation for the usable surface: \(3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572\text{ cm²}\). Perspective and cropped edges make this approximate.

**3 — Items:** Cooked reddish-brown rice, corn on the cob, red pepper, leafy greens, and a few pale vegetable pieces, possibly mushroom or onion. No separate sauce or measurable oil is clearly visible.
